notes.title: The Retrospection Of Tomorrow – Kickstarter Now Live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Our Kickstarter is finally live~ 🎉
It has been a week and we reached 60% already!

Our goal is to raise $12,000 CAD in 31 days (4-3~5-3) to cover finished localization, a basic OST, logo design, PV commission, and various art commissions—plus prep funds for Act 3’s development.

With your support, we can unlock stretch goals like voice acting and additional content!

If you love the game, [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/471024798/the-retrospection-of-tomorrow-romance-vn-about-time-travel]definitely check it out and help bring the Deluxe Version to life![/url] 💫

notes.title: The Retrospection Of Tomorrow Demo Launch! (PC, Mac, Steamdeck)
notes.content:
For those who have played, you already know this story unfolds in a nonlinear way, offering a unique visual novel experience✨

This demo includes TROT's Act 1 content, with an estimated playtime of 3-5 hours. You’ll meet the 4 romanceable characters in this demo: a childhood friend, a transfer student, a college classmate… and even a professor(?)

This is just the beginning of a time-travel adventure spanning decades—hope you enjoy the ride!
